title: Owens summons lightning near the Camden Bridge

tellings.quote: Owens pointed his finger at the bridge and according to the affidavit, lightning struck within a few moments, not hitting the bridge, but in that general vicinity.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena, tells a story about Ted Owens, a man who claimed he could control weather and events with his mind, and who was the subject of a book called The PK Man (PK means psychokinesis, moving things with the mind). According to a sworn written statement by a man named Sydney Margolies, sometime in the 1960s near the Camden Bridge in Philadelphia, Owens pointed his finger at the bridge and lightning struck the area around it within a few moments. If true, it would suggest a person could call down lightning at will.
